original_ai_output.title_zh: 教宗良十四世呼吁埃塞俄比亚对话，提格雷战火重燃
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 教宗良十四世周三在圣彼得广场发表讲话，呼吁埃塞俄比亚北部最新一轮暴力事件的所有相关方选择对话道路。埃塞俄比亚联邦军队与提格雷人民解放阵线（TPLF）附属武装之间的战斗上周升级，破坏了2022年结束两年毁灭性战争的和平协议。报道称，反叛武装已动员起来，希望通过武装斗争推翻联邦总理。

location.raw_text: Tigray and the neighbouring Ethiopian regions of Afar and Amhara

key_facts.fact: 教宗良十四世呼吁埃塞俄比亚北部冲突各方选择对话
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Pope Leo XIV made an appeal for peace in Tigray and the neighbouring Ethiopian regions of Afar and Amhara on Wednesday, inviting all parties involved "to choose the path of dialogue."

key_facts.fact: 埃塞俄比亚联邦军队与提格雷人民解放阵线（TPLF）附属武装之间的战斗上周升级
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Renewed fighting between Ethiopian federal troops and fighters affiliated to the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) escalated last week, shattering a peace pact that ended a devastating two-year war in 2022.

key_facts.fact: 2022年结束两年战争的和平协议被破坏
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: shattering a peace pact that ended a devastating two-year war in 2022

key_facts.fact: 反叛武装动员起来，希望通过武装斗争推翻联邦总理
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The rebel forces mobilised for an armed struggle they hope will lead to the removal of the federal prime minister.

uncertainties: 事件目前仅有一个来源（Africanews）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
反叛武装的动员规模与具体行动细节尚未证实
